description: This file contains the implementation of the transformation logic for AWS Bedrock CountTokens API within a larger codebase. It handles converting requests from the Anthropic Messages API format to AWS Bedrock's format and vice versa, including request validation, endpoint URL construction, and response transformation.

classes.name: BedrockCountTokensConfig
classes.description: Configuration and transformation logic for AWS Bedrock CountTokens API.

methods.name: str _detect_input_type(self, request_data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Detects whether the request uses 'converse' or 'invokeModel' input format.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] transform_anthropic_to_bedrock_count_tokens( self, request_data: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Transforms a request from Anthropic format to Bedrock CountTokens API format.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _transform_to_converse_format( self, messages: List[Dict[str, Any]] )
methods.description: Converts message list to Bedrock 'converse' input format.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _transform_to_invoke_model_format( self, request_data: Dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Converts request data to Bedrock 'invokeModel' input format with raw body.

methods.name: str get_bedrock_count_tokens_endpoint( self, model: str, aws_region_name: str )
methods.description: Generates the AWS Bedrock CountTokens API endpoint URL based on model and region.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] transform_bedrock_response_to_anthropic( self, bedrock_response: Dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Transforms Bedrock response into Anthropic request format.

methods.name: None validate_count_tokens_request(self, request_data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Validates incoming count tokens requests for both input formats.
